title: Sprint G5 - global capture and triage
description: SPRINT BRIEF (phase 3). Capture-first inbox: notes and discoveries land globally with zero routing decisions at capture time, and a triage flow later promotes each item into a project, keeps it global, or drops it. The machinery mostly exists workspace-scoped (memory raw inbox plus the boreal-raw-inbox workflow and skill); what is missing is that capture requires knowing the destination, which is backwards - capture and clarify are different moments. Scope: bwrk capture from any cwd into the global inbox; triage routing that promotes an inbox item to a target project as work, claim, decision, or source carrying a provenance reference back to the capture (uses sprint G3 URIs); inbox surfacing on the global dashboard with aging nudges. Scope guard from the design doc: global work items are only portfolio containers, cross-repo chores, and triaged items belonging to no repo - triage should actively push repo-specific items into their repos so the global backlog never becomes a junk drawer.
acceptanceCriteria: All child tasks closed with passed verification evidence
